questions.title: Second Largest Distinct
questions.prompt: Return the second largest distinct integer in nums. Return None if fewer than two distinct values exist. Do not sort the entire list.
questions.hint: Track the largest and second-largest distinct values while scanning.

questions.title: Valley Array
questions.prompt: Return True if nums strictly decreases to one interior minimum and then strictly increases. The minimum cannot be the first or last element.
questions.hint: Walk down while values decrease, then walk up while values increase.

questions.title: First Pair Sum
questions.prompt: Return the indices of the first pair encountered during a left-to-right scan whose values add to target. Return [] if no pair exists.
questions.hint: Store value -> earliest index in a dictionary.

questions.title: Longest Unique Window
questions.prompt: Return the length of the longest substring with no repeated characters.
questions.hint: Use a sliding window and store the most recent index of each character.

questions.title: Batch Range Sums
questions.prompt: Given nums and queries where each query is [left, right] inclusive, return the sum for every query.
questions.hint: Build a prefix sum array with one extra leading zero.
